description: SL Energiequellen Biogas- und Windkraftanlagen - Ressourcen erneuerbarer Energien und Abfallressourcen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by LVGL. This service provides data implemented for the INSPIRE topic energy sources from the data sets biogas plants and wind turbines in the Saarland.:This layer visualizes the Saarland resources of renewable energies and waste resources modelled with the corresponding geospatial data. The data base complies with the INSPIRE data specification. Coverage: LVGL. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE-WMS SL Energy Sources Biogas and Wind Turbines - Renewable Energy Resources and Waste Resources" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is LVGL. Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, Ressourcen, Ressource, Waste, opendata, HVD. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
